email_subject: Application - Digital Engagement and Campaigns Officer
email_body:
Dear FYEG team,

I am writing to apply for the Digital Engagement and Campaigns Officer position. My background combines copywriting, content management and digital marketing with a technical foundation in web and automation. At Episto, I write SEO content, manage CMS pages and use analytics to track performance; as a freelancer, I build and optimise websites, including structured data and enquiry flows that turn visitors into contacts. I work independently, organise multiple projects, and communicate clearly in English.

I want to bring this mix to FYEG's digital community and campaigns. I am comfortable with digital tools, eager to learn your CRM and platform systems, and motivated by FYEG's green, feminist, anti-racist and social justice values. I would welcome the chance to support your volunteers, campaigns and coordinated actions.

Thank you for your consideration.

Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear FYEG team,

I am applying for the Digital Engagement and Campaigns Officer role. I am a digital marketer with a technical background, working across SEO, content, web and automation. My experience is hands-on: I write copy that informs and converts, manage CMS content, run technical audits, and use analytics to see what works. At Episto, I handle on-page SEO, keyword research and SEO content for client websites, publish and update pages and blog posts in WordPress, and track performance with Semrush, Ahrefs, Google Analytics and Search Console. As a freelancer, I designed, built and run baverok.com, including a hand-coded landing page, structured data and an enquiry flow. For mirook.com, I built and optimised a multi-page site and ran iterative technical SEO/GEO audits. Earlier, at Knowledge Experts, I supported SharePoint-based digital workplace sites and built WordPress sites for clients; at ViviDoctor, I developed front-end features for a healthcare web application.

This role asks for organisation, copywriting, digital literacy, volunteer engagement and campaign support. My work has taught me to manage several client projects and deadlines, communicate clearly and take initiative when something needs fixing. I am fluent in English, native in Turkish, with Dutch at B1 writing and A2+ speaking, so I am comfortable in multi-cultural teams. I am eager to learn FYEG's CRM and digital platform, and to help connect your digital community with campaigns and the Executive Committee. I am also willing to travel and work occasional evenings or weekends.

I am motivated by FYEG's green, feminist, anti-racist and social justice values. I would bring reliable content, technical problem-solving and a people-focused approach to your digital engagement and fundraising campaigns. Thank you for considering my application.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok

cv_highlights:
- Copywriting and content: SEO blog and website writing, CMS content management in WordPress/Elementor/Astra/Rank Math, and Shopify product and blog content for client stores.
- Digital campaign and audience tools: on-page SEO, keyword research, technical audits, structured data/JSON-LD, llms.txt, enquiry flows, and analytics with Google Analytics, Search Console, Semrush and Ahrefs.
- Digital literacy and automation: daily LLM use, prompt engineering, MCP integrations into WordPress and SEO tools, Python automation, HTML/CSS/JavaScript, and an Android app live on Google Play.
- Organised independent work: freelance and remote roles managing multiple client websites (baverok.com, mirook.com, etkendanismanlik.com, proteinbox.com.tr, majistraleczacilari.org.tr, harwindtf.com, custompremiumshirt.com) and supporting SharePoint digital workplace sites for ŞOK Market and Aras Kargo at KXP.
- Languages and teamwork: English fluent, Turkish native, Dutch B1 writing/A2+ speaking; experience in client teams and cross-border remote collaboration, including Belgium-based and Turkish projects.
